rv.q: Paramount, in short, has another huge hit on its hands.

Heidi Schreck's expertly written, carefully researched play is a profoundly personal examination of the U.S. Constitution and its failure to protect all the nation's citizens: Indigenous people, people of color, members of the LGBTQIA+ community and women.
What the Constitution Means to Me at Paramount’s Copley Theatre should be experienced – plain and simple.

cn.t: Critics praise this thought-provoking, intimate production for its contemporary relevance and non-traditional structure, blending history lesson with personal storytelling. Goodrich's performance expands her repertoire in a play that powerfully resonates today.
